papers.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state. papers.llm_reason: Argus 直接命中 AI Agent 架构主线：据摘要，它是一个持久化、自演化的 agentic runtime，由 Manager、Planner、Engineer、Reviewer 四角色在持久项目状态上执行有界任务（bounded missions）；其核心设计是把稳定的用户意图与可变的操作目标、约束、验证标准分离，并接入 memories、skills、procedure（摘要截断）。'把用户意图与操作目标/约束/验证标准分离'+'持久项目状态 + 角色分工 + 有界任务'是任何构建多步 agent 的团队都可直接参考的架构模式——尤其适用于需要 agent 在证据支持时坚持、在测量发现失败时转向的长程推理场景。命中 ai-agent 主线（keywords: agent/agentic/benchmark）。证据强度中等偏上：角色分工与状态分离的架构描述清晰，'持久 + 自演化 + 有界任务'的设计约束有针对性。证据不足：全部 code/benchmark/Papers with Code/OpenReview 链接暂无待核验；摘要截断导致 procedure 之后的内容缺失；有界任务的边界如何定义、自演化机制的具体实现、与现有 agent 框架的定量对比需正文确认。

papers.title: Reasoning Core: Designing Broad Procedural Data for Completion-Supervised Reasoning Training
papers.abstract: Procedural generators produce useful verifiable reasoning problems at scale, but have received less attention as data for completion-supervised fine-tuning. We introduce Reasoning Core, a collection of 50 generators spanning mathematics, logic, planning, state tracking, formal languages, structured data, games, causality, and code, with semantic scorers, difficulty controls, and task evaluators. papers.llm_reason: Reasoning Core 命中推理训练数据生成主线：据摘要，它是一个包含 50 个程序化生成器的集合，覆盖数学、逻辑、规划、状态跟踪、形式语言、结构化数据、博弈、因果、代码九大类，配备语义评分器、难度控制和任务评估器；在 matched completion-supervised 协议下与 Procedural Warmup、Rea（摘要截断）对比。'程序化生成可验证推理问题 + 难度控制 + 语义评分器'可直接迁移到团队的推理训练数据合成流水线——尤其适用于需要规模化生产可验证 CoT 训练数据的场景。命中 ai-agent（planning）与 context-engineering 主线。证据强度中等偏上：50 个生成器的覆盖面广、有 matched protocol 对照实验。证据不足：全部 code/benchmark 暂无待核验；摘要截断导致对比基线 Rea 之后的内容缺失；生成器的具体构造、难度控制机制、与基线的定量增益需正文确认。

papers.title: OctoLong: Mid-Training On Cross-Repository Code Contexts Enhances Long-Context Modeling
papers.abstract: Context lengths of language models (LMs) have dramatically increased, driven by the demands for in-context learning, self-improvement, and long-horizon agentic workflows. Existing long-context corpora, however, are dominated by books, academic articles, and code repositories, which are finite resources and often scarce in long-distance dependencies. In this work, we introduce OctoLong, a context engineering pipeline that instruments an AST parser, a language server backend, and a package manager
papers.llm_reason: OctoLong 命中 context-engineering 与 coding-agent 主线：据摘要，现有长上下文语料被书籍、论文、代码仓库主导，这些资源有限且长距离依赖稀疏；OctoLong 提出一个 context engineering 流水线，用 AST 解析器、language server 后端和包管理器（摘要截断）从跨仓库代码上下文构造长上下文训练数据，用于 mid-training。'用 AST + language server + 包管理器从跨仓库代码构造长距离依赖丰富的长上下文语料'是一个对长上下文模型训练数据工程有参考价值的方法论。趋势信号中等偏上：长上下文是当前核心能力需求，而高质量长上下文训练语料的构造方法是被忽视的工程问题。证据强度中等：流水线组件（AST/language server/package manager）描述清晰。证据不足：全部 code/benchmark 暂无待核验；摘要截断导致流水线完整流程缺失；mid-training 的具体协议、长上下文性能提升的定量结果需正文确认；摘要关键词 agent/agentic 为宽泛命中（指 agentic workflows 是长上下文需求来源之一），实际是训练数据工程而非 agent 方法。

papers.title: Toward Skill-Native LLMs: Skill Entropy for Benchmarking and Training Long-Horizon Reasoning
papers.abstract: Long-horizon reasoning in recent LLMs demands that the model switch between distinct skills inside a reasoning chain, such as first doing a math derivation, then using the result to plan a schedule. We call such problems cross-skill long-horizon tasks: multi-step tasks whose steps require different reasoning skills and depend on earlier outputs. Existing benchmarks often evaluate individual skills, lacking a principled way to measure how well a model switches between skills. We address this gap
papers.llm_reason: Skill Entropy 命中 llm-evaluation 与 long-horizon reasoning 主线：据摘要，长程推理要求模型在推理链中切换不同技能（如先做数学推导，再用结果规划调度）；本文称之为 cross-skill long-horizon tasks——步骤需要不同推理技能且依赖前序输出的多步任务；现有 benchmark 通常只评估单项技能，缺少衡量模型技能切换能力的原则化方法；本文提出 Skill Entropy 填补这一空白。'衡量模型在推理链中切换技能的能力'是一个对评估 agent/长程推理有直接参考价值的评测视角——尤其适用于需要判断模型在多技能串联任务上真实能力的场景。命中 llm-evaluation 主线。证据强度中等：问题定位（现有 benchmark 缺少技能切换度量）与评测动机清晰。证据不足：全部 code/benchmark 暂无待核验；Skill Entropy 的具体数学定义、cross-skill 任务集的构造、与现有 benchmark 的相关性分析需正文确认。

papers.title: Spoken Function Calling: A New Perspective on Spoken Language Understanding for Large Audio Language Models
papers.abstract: Spoken Language Understanding (SLU) is the core component of task-oriented dialogue systems and a pivotal link in achieving seamless human-agent interaction. While traditional SLU can effectively extract user semantics for closed-set tasks after in-domain supervised fine-tuning, it faces significant challenges in leveraging in-context learning for open-domain tasks due to its ambiguous rule definitions. This work proposes Spoken Function Calling (SFC), a novel semantic understanding perspective
papers.llm_reason: Spoken Function Calling (SFC) 命中 ai-agent 与 function calling 主线：据摘要，传统 SLU 在领域内监督微调后能有效提取封闭任务的语义，但在开放领域任务中利用 in-context learning 的能力受限，因其规则定义模糊；本文提出 SFC 这一新的语义理解视角（摘要截断），面向 Large Audio Language Models。'把 function calling 的语义理解范式扩展到语音模态'是 function calling 能力从文本向多模态延伸的一个趋势信号——尤其适用于需要语音交互的 agent 场景。命中 ai-agent（function calling）主线。证据强度中等：问题定位（传统 SLU 难以利用 ICL）清晰。证据不足：全部 code/benchmark 暂无待核验；摘要截断导致 SFC 具体方法缺失；SFC 与文本 function calling 的对应关系、在 audio LLM 上的实验设计需正文确认；摘要关键词 RAG 为宽泛命中，实际指 spoken language understanding 而非检索增强生成系统。

papers.title: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does
papers.abstract: Gradient descent on a factored model $W = UV^\top$ is implicitly biased toward low-rank solutions, while Adam, starting from the same small initialization, is not. We trace the difference to the gauge symmetry of the loss, its invariance under $(U, V) \mapsto (UQ, VQ)$. Gradient flow's low-rank mechanism is available to an optimizer only if that optimizer is gauge-equivariant, a condition necessary for the transfer but not sufficient for low-rank recovery. papers.llm_reason: The Loss Does Not See the Basis, but Adam Does 提供了一个关于优化器隐式偏置的理论发现：据摘要，在分解模型 W=UV^T 上，梯度下降隐式偏向低秩解，而 Adam 从同样小初始化出发则不会；作者将差异追溯到 loss 的 gauge symmetry（在 (U,V)→(UQ,VQ) 下的不变性），指出梯度流的低秩机制仅在优化器 gauge-equivariant 时才可用——这是必要但不充分条件；梯度下降、动量、'shared-sca'（摘要截断）满足该条件。这是一个关于'为什么 GD 找低秩但 Adam 不找'的理论解释，对理解训练动态与优化器选型有长尾参考价值。命中 cs.LG（理论）。证据强度中等偏上：理论推导（gauge equivariance 条件）逻辑清晰。证据不足：全部 code/benchmark 暂无待核验；摘要截断导致 shared-sca 之后的内容缺失；gauge-equivariant 条件的完整刻画、实验验证需正文确认；理论性较强，与团队以 Agent/工程为核心的技术栈直接迁移距离中等。
